instrumentation.scope: Direct view drawing/animation test; does not exercise Projectivy rendering.

performanceBaseline.note: Captured before waveform split, during real AuraMusic focus. This is the optimization baseline; not a controlled power benchmark.

optimization.change: Split static artwork into an ImageView and animated bars into a separate child View, so 20 fps waveform invalidations do not redraw the artwork view.
optimization.dirtyRectApiDecision: Did not use dirty-rectangle invalidation because Android documents that it is ignored on API 21+ hardware-accelerated drawing.
optimization.reason: No AuraMusic Quick Picks channel remained after the connected Gradle test removed the target package; current data could not reproduce real AuraMusic focus on the optimized build.

deviceTestSideEffect.details: The connected AndroidTest task removed com.auramusic.app.debug from the Chromecast after its focused test passed. Reinstalled the candidate APK immediately. Android reported firstInstallTime 2026-11-08 20:30:02, restoreSet=0, and no backup transport client. The previous private listening-history/Quick Picks state and AccessibilityService grant were not restored.
deviceTestSideEffect.recovery: Reinstalled candidate APK; re-enabled AuraMusic focused preview indicator through Android Settings; returned Projectivy to foreground. The app opens to generic Take it easy/New releases rows, while the old Quick Picks Projectivy channel is absent.

remainingGates: Restore/rebuild AuraMusic listening history or Quick Picks so the optimized APK can be verified against real cards on Projectivy
Compare post-optimization CPU/memory with the 60-second real-preview baseline
